candidates.name: Lymphoma
support_spans: bilateral vesicular breathing with diffuse rhonchi on lung auscultation
innumerable ill-defined nodular opacities within both lungs
marked FDG-avid uptake at the lung lesion, right neck lymph node, and left acetabular bone marrow
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging results suggest a widespread disease affecting the lungs and lymph nodes, consistent with lymphoma.

candidates.name: Sarcoidosis
support_spans: bilateral vesicular breathing with diffuse rhonchi on lung auscultation
innumerable ill-defined nodular opacities within both lungs
contradict_spans: marked FDG-avid uptake at the lung lesion, right neck lymph node, and left acetabular bone marrow
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging results could suggest sarcoidosis, but the presence of marked FDG-avid uptake and atypical lymphoid cells makes this less likely.

candidates.name: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
support_spans: patchy areas of large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis
infiltration of lung parenchyma by malignant neoplasm, mixed inflammatory infiltrate, marked nuclear pleomorphism with atypical mitotic figures
candidates.why: The patient's biopsy results suggest a malignant neoplasm with atypical lymphoid cells, consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
